entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Can I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Thank you, Sarah. I have your account here. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's a fault. The pulse tracker is completely broken. It gives me readings that are all over the place, and half the time it won't sync the data to my phone anyway.
I see. So you're saying the device seems defective because of the inaccurate pulse readings and syncing problems. I understand that must be frustrating.
It is. I just want to return it.
Of course. Let me just check the return eligibility for your order. One moment please.
Okay, thank you for waiting, Sarah. I see you received the VeloBand 18 days ago. Let me just pull up our policy... yes, according to our records, you are well within the 90-day return window.
Oh. So you're just going to take it back? No hassle?

That's correct. Since you're reporting the item as defective and it's within the policy timeframe, I've gone ahead and approved the return. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off.

I've just sent it. You should see it in your inbox shortly. Once our warehouse receives the return, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a better rest of your day.
